column2: (2) Any person who commits an offence under subsection

column1: (1) shall  be guilty of  an offence and shall on conviction
after  summary  trial  before  a  Magistrate  be  liable  to
imprisonment of either description for a term not exceeding
one  year  or  to  a  fine  not  less  than  two  hundred  thousand
rupees or to both such imprisonment and fine.
